item.title: Bank accounts with deposits of over ¥100 million surge, BOJ says
item.description: This is likely the result of growing asset values amid rising stock prices, making the trend of wealth concentration among the rich more pronounced.

item.title: Japan’s Princess Aiko returns from Singapore visit

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
